links.outcome: Staff views on whether the risk algorithm identified all suitable patients for care coordination
links.effect: Algorithm identified previously hospitalised patients but missed suitable community patients at increasing risk; clinician referrals were an important additional selection mechanism.
links.quote: While the algorithm effectively identified previously hospitalised patients, it did not identify all suitable patients in the community with an increasing risk of requiring acute health care intervention.

screen.reason: Evaluates staff experiences with real-world deployment of a hospitalization risk prediction algorithm and examines the practice of augmenting algorithmic screening with clinician referrals.

primary.practice: combining algorithm identification with clinician referral
